t: These are six large detached villas on the north-western edge of Regent's Park, designed by Quinlan Terry between 1988 and 2004. Each one is in a different classical style, meant to show the variety of classical architecture. They are the Ionic Villa, the Veneto Villa, the Gothick Villa, the Corinthian Villa, the Regency Villa and the Doric Villa. Terry is a New Classical architect and a winner of the Driehaus Prize. He trained as a pupil of Raymond Erith, and the two formed the partnership Erith and Terry.
